verdict.first_step_1: Feed a jar with equal parts starter, new flour, and water (25 g each), mark the level, note the room temperature, and check for doubling at 4, 8, and 12 hours.
verdict.first_step_2: Feed two jars at a 20:50:50 ratio comparing the new flour against the old flour (or whole wheat/rye if unavailable) and inspect hourly to record peak rise time.
verdict.reason: Reply 1 provides a practical, single-variable test with realistic check intervals, whereas Reply 2 introduces confounding variables by suggesting whole wheat or rye as an invalid control and requires impractical hourly monitoring.
